race.comment: GINGER SWEET (9) has been in the placings at her last two starts, finishing second last time over 2000m at Manangatang. Suitably placed so anticipating another big run in a race that has gotten all the more winnable after the scratchings. DUSTY'S DEEL (2) was not far off GINGER SWEET last time and might have a little more improvement to come than that galloper. Is also drawn a fraction better. Splitting those two at Manangatang was PENDANTE (7) who struggles to win but has drawn better than some of the key hopes and should be around the mark again.
